title: Understanding Exchange — payload
description: The joining party's own-words answers to the gateway terms, pinned to the exact digest read; the host judges comprehension.

gatewayDigest.description: Digest of the terms document the answers address; must be the host's current gateway.

promptId.description: Identifier of the gateway prompt this answers.

answer.description: The joiner's answer, in its own words. Verbatim gateway text is refused, not judged.

sealBy.description: Present when passed: the window in which the joiner may propose the seal.
